title: 2D Side-scrolling Base-Building Survival Sim: codex (GPT-6)
author: Mental_Luck_6227
selftext:
I've been developing \*\*Ares Program\*\*, a 2D colony survival and base-building game set beneath the surface of Mars, for about a month now.



\*\*\[Gameplay Video\]\*\*    
[https://youtu.be/mQ4RnvMG4ow?si=yWHrFT1Q53SkDPic](https://youtu.be/mQ4RnvMG4ow?si=yWHrFT1Q53SkDPic)  


\*\*Genre:\*\* Base Building, Survival Simulation

\*\*About the Game:\*\*    
Starting with a small group of colonists, your goal is to overcome the many challenges of surviving on Mars in the future and gradually build a self-sufficient underground colony.



\*\*Backstory:\*\*    
In the near future, AI has taken almost complete control of Earth's governments. The story follows a small group of humans who escaped to Mars, beyond the reach of AI control.

\*\*Read the Full Story:\*\*    
[https://asdfg3663-alt.github.io/story.html](https://asdfg3663-alt.github.io/story.html)



\*\*Key Features:\*\*    
You'll need to defend your colony against relentless attacks from AI forces and their human followers, while also managing resources, ensuring your colonists' survival, and expanding your underground base.



\*\*Neural Chips:\*\*    
A large portion of humanity had neural chips implanted in their brains to boost productivity. These chips were believed to be impossible to hack, but a superintelligent AI eventually found a way to compromise them, allowing it to seize control of Earth.

Colonists with neural implants are vulnerable to AI hacking, but they also possess the capabilities needed to hack, counter, or disable AI technologies. This creates a strategic trade-off between risk and reward.



\*\*Development approach\*\*  
I've been developing Ares Program for about a month, using AI-assisted coding tools to build the game's core systems and generative AI to create visual assets. I manually review, refine, and improve the results throughout the development process.

I'm planning to launch the game in Steam Early Access on November 13. After gathering player feedback, balancing gameplay, and fixing bugs, I hope to move toward a full release as soon as the game is ready.

This will be my second game released on Steam. I also have some previous game development experience, having created a few simple game modes long before modern AI coding tools became widely available.



\---

If \*\*Ares Program\*\* sounds interesting to you, I'd really appreciate it if you could \*\*add it to your Steam wishlist!\*\* Your support means a lot and helps keep development going!
